claims.statement: Every finite-depth fresh-block hierarchy obtained by common point-defect modulation of an LTF has a complete physical stopping tree with actual LTF leaves, exact nonreusing path/terminal influence decomposition, path constant strictly below 4, and total FEI constant C_LTF<8.937.
claims.quantifiers: Every depth L>=0; every base dimension; every genuine Boolean LTF base; every sequence of positive point-defect block dimensions.
claims.units: base-two spectral entropy and uniform-cube total influence
hypotheses: each modulation block is fresh and disjoint
the same point-defect modulator multiplies every current input at a level
the base is a genuine Boolean LTF
claims.limitations: Does not cover unequal branch squared spectra, reused blocks, bent splices, or arbitrary Boolean bases; full FEI remains open.
